offering_description.value: Sells software and access to audience data to brands, advertising agencies, publishers and advertising technology companies. Its cloud platform helps customers match customer records, collaborate on data, reach audiences across media channels and measure campaign results.

primary_products.value: Identity resolution software; data clean rooms; audience activation software; campaign measurement software; third-party audience datasets

primary_services.value: Data strategy consulting; platform implementation; managed campaign measurement

customer_segment.value: B2B: Brands, advertising agencies, media owners, advertising technology platforms and data providers

end_markets.value: Advertising and media; retail and consumer goods; financial services; travel and hospitality; automotive

revenue_model.value: subscription: Contracted access to identity resolution, data collaboration, activation and measurement tools; transaction or usage fees: Use of third-party audience data in advertising campaigns

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Connects customer and partner data for brands, agencies, publishers and advertising platforms; distributor: Makes audience datasets from third-party providers available to advertisers and agencies

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Identity resolution, data collaboration, audience activation, campaign measurement and an audience data marketplace

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Enterprise sales teams serving brands, agencies, publishers and technology companies; partners / resellers: Advertising platforms and data partners that integrate audience data and identity tools into their products

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Personal data processing and targeted advertising under the EU GDPR, California CCPA and other state privacy laws

notes: The extent to which implementation and managed services are billed separately is uncertain.
